HRVS SDK
HRVS SDK Change Log

Version HRVS_SDK_1.0.12 (released 28th of March 2025)

  • Features:
    • Extended ability for HRVS SDK users to customize radar configuration parameters
      • Added new RadarConfig structure (holds all user-configurable radar parameters), which can be passed to setConfigurations() method (previously, all radar parameter values were determined solely by the enum RadarType selection)
    • Integrated newest EAP model ffba6cc
  • Bug Fixes:
    • Fixed flush methods inside log/file writer asynchronous implementations
    • Extended GPIO pinIdentifier type from uint8_t to unsigned in GPIOPinLinux
  • Refactoring:
    • Added constants holding default values for all user-configurable parameters
    • Removed duplicate default value assignments in HRVS SDK examples

Version HRVS_SDK_1.0.11 (released 8th of January 2025)

  • Integrated EAP model 62a05e3
  • Added support for body velocity input via runMeasurement() method in HRVS SDK

  • Moved synthetic range/velocity data injection from runMeasurement() parameters into dedicated methods

  • Changed default value of some config parameters (startfreq: 62.0 -> 61.75, frameTriggerDelay: 1->15)
  • Removed redundant data logging, i.e. big object data

Version HRVS_SDK_1.0.10 (released 24th of July 2024)

  • Fixed timeout issue during reception of 'CONFIG ACKNOWLEDGMENT MESSAGE' by increasing the wait time after radar resets.
  • Increased UART input buffer length from 4096B to 64kB to handle larger messages.
  • Fixed issue with flushing the UART input buffer to prevent reception of incorrect messages or messages with incorrect radar IDs after failed measurements.
  • Corrected handling of 'OBJECT INFO MESSAGE' and 'FILTERED POINT MESSAGE' when they have no useful payload.

Version HRVS_SDK_1.0.9 (released 8th of July 2024)

  • Added possibility to select destination folder for extended HRVS SDK logging

Passing logs destination folder to RadarSystem constructor

Extended logs in destination folder

  • Extended duration of radar triggering pulse to 1 ms (short pulse was causing communication issues)
  • Optimized logging of HRVS SDK information logs (and radar messages) to STDOUT (and csv files)
  • Updated README file to include recommended lengths of communication cables, give more information about included HRVS SDK libraries and fixed typos

Version HRVS_SDK_1.0.8 (released 19th of June 2024)

  • Added debug mode which enabled: extended HRVS SDK logging in current working directory and possibility to replace data coming from radars by injected values
